1.title: Troy Jackson Tightens Hold on Democratic Senate Nomination in Maine
1.summary: State Democrats released a ballot for their nominating convention on Saturday that includes Mr. Jackson and two long-shot candidates with little public support from delegates.

2.title: Small Plane Crashes Into House Near Houston
2.summary: The plane, a Piper J3C-65, struck the house in Fulshear, Texas, around 6:45 a.m. on Monday, the authorities said. Its pilot was in serious condition on Tuesday, a hospital spokesman said.

3.title: Senate Panel Advances Jay Clayton as Next Spy Chief on Party-Line Vote
3.summary: If the full Senate confirms him as expected, Mr. Clayton will take over the Office of the Director of National Intelligence from Bill Pulte, a housing official with little national security experience.

4.title: Zelensky Dismisses Ukraine’s Top General After Protests
4.summary: The move followed the firing of a popular defense minister, who had clashed with the general over how to fight the war.

5.title: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
5.summary: Oleksandr Syrskyi is dismissed after backlash over the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

6.title: Netanyahu Ad Uses a Questionable Tactic Against Bereaved Rival
6.summary: A.I.-generated images showing Gadi Eisenkot, the Israeli leader’s top challenger in upcoming elections, played on anti-Arab sentiments and used images seen as disrespectful to his son, who was killed in the recent Gaza war.
